audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 read 'Skill' though whys[0] says you out-DPS him there, and 2+ items read 'Skill' though whys[6] and late both give the stage to Swain.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Urgot for rows 0-5 and Swain at two items, the mirror flipped its rows to that same packet read, and the 56.04% win rate over 687 games supports it.
audit.corrected: Urgot Levels 1 through First item; Swain at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike is built on a 25% execute number and on the claim that your R interrupts Demonic Ascension.
audit.why: Riot's Fear Beyond Death text gives no numeric threshold. Demonic Ascension is a transformation, not a channel — the kit carries no channel flag, so no interrupt can be asserted. What Riot's text does say is that the form is indefinite only as long as Swain drains enemy champions, so dragging him off his targets starves it out.
audit.corrected: Fear Beyond Death does not cancel Demonic Ascension; it drags him off the champions the form needs to keep draining. It is 120s flat at every rank.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nevermove is described as 'a returning bolt that roots enemies it hits' with no cooldown, range, or the fact that only the return pass roots.
audit.why: Riot's E text: the wave travels forward, then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits on the way back — the outbound pass does not root. It is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s at 850 range and has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension. Ravenous Flock heals him and permanently raises his maximum health, so Grievous Wounds timing matters more than resistances.
audit.corrected: Nevermove roots on the return pass, not the way out — keep moving once the bolt has gone by, and remember its cooldown shortens while his ult is up.

edits.before: - Swain Demonic Ascension: matchup-defining — His drain. Don’t fight into it. Track it before every engage. - Swain Nevermove: A returning bolt that roots enemies it hits — his catch tool. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Nevermove: 12s at rank 1, 850 range — it roots on the RETURN pass, not the way out, so keep moving after the bolt goes by. - Demonic Ascension: 120s flat, and it holds only while he drains.

notes: packet suspectName on wants.foe[1] ('Ramp Demonic Ascension drain') is a false positive — the name is correct. The real error was the repeated claim that Fear Beyond Death interrupts Demonic Ascension: Swain's R is a transformation with no channel flag in Riot's data, so no interrupt is assertable. Rewritten as starving the form of drain targets, which Riot's own text supports.
